correctness.rationale: Commuting uE+N with u!=0, E²=E, N nilpotent is equivalent to χ_A=t^(n−r)(t−u)^r (or nilpotence). Every coefficient curve C_r is closed by integrality of u from u^r; its inverse image is irreducible via triangular matrices with prescribed diagonal under conjugation. Each fixed-characteristic-polynomial fiber has dimension n²−n by the complete-flag upper bound and a cyclic companion orbit lower bound; varying u gives dim n²−n+1. Distinct r components intersect exactly in the nilpotent cone of dimension n²−n. The finite-field count follows from unique primary eigenspace decompositions and Fine–Herstein q^(s²−s); Gaussian binomial asymptotics give (q−1)nq^(−n)/c_q+O_q(q^(−n)). Independent enumeration of small n/q checked numeric counts. Geometric statements are set-theoretic reduced components, not scheme multiplicities.
